challenge: Damage Mechanics Challenge (Purdue/LLNL/Sandia, information packet of 15 Jan 2022) — fallback for SFC3
status: FROZEN blind prediction, made 2026-11-14/15 (UTC) from calibration data only; not graded

Q1_load_displacement.post_peak: abrupt (unstable): the structural solution falls to 11 % of peak within one increment of 0.0026 mm; in the measured record this is a vertical drop to about 2 % of peak followed by a low tail

Q2_crack_path.initiation: at the notch root; first on the deep (front, y=-6.35) side of the tapered notch
Q2_crack_path.description: single crack; twists from the 26.6-degree skewed notch plane towards a plane normal to the beam axis and drifts towards the loading rod (x=0)
Q2_crack_path.crack_x_mm_at_heights_note: raw model values; reliable up to about z = -12 mm, above that biased towards vertical (see correction)

Q3_surface_displacement_fields: not submitted (the solver output exists but was not post-processed into the requested 100-micron grids)

model.method: AT2 phase-field fracture, hybrid formulation (isotropic degradation, spectral tensile driving force, history-field irreversibility), staggered to convergence
model.solver: own JAX code pf3d.py, hex8 tensor grid, GPU Jacobi-PCG
model.contact_compliance: delta = -0.128 + delta_FE + 0.0438 * P^0.379 (mm, N), fitted to the 16 calibration beams
